cases.explain: «царского сановника» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

cases.sentence: Он сказал им просить у Бога небес милости, чтобы Он открыл им эту тайну, и они не были казнены вместе с остальными ___.
cases.explain: «вавилонскими мудрецами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

cases.sentence: А мне эта тайна была открыта не потому, что у меня больше мудрости, чем у ___, но для того, чтобы ты, о царь, мог узнать истолкование и понять то, что прошло через твой ум.
cases.explain: «прочих людей» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

cases.sentence: Ты посмотрел, о царь, и вот, перед тобой стояла ___ — огромная, сияющая ослепительным блеском, ужасная на вид статуя.
cases.explain: «большая статуя» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

cases.sentence: Ты посмотрел, о царь, и вот, перед тобой стояла большая статуя — огромная, сияющая ___, ужасная на вид статуя.
cases.explain: «ослепительным блеском» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

cases.sentence: Голова статуи была из ___, грудь и руки из серебра, живот и бедра из бронзы, 33 ноги из железа, а ступни частью из железа, частью из обожженной глины.
cases.explain: «чистого золота» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its breast and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

cases.sentence: Пока ты смотрел, откололся камень, без помощи ___.
cases.explain: «человеческих рук» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

cases.sentence: Бог небес дал тебе владычество и силу, могущество и славу; 38 Он отдал в твои руки человеческий род, полевых зверей и ___.
cases.explain: «небесных птиц» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

cases.explain: «золотая голова» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

cases.sentence: После него — ___, бронзовое, которое будет править всей землей.
cases.explain: «третье царство» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

cases.sentence: Наконец, явится четвертое царство, крепкое, как железо — ведь железо все разбивает и все крушит — и как ___, оно раздробит и сокрушит все остальные.
cases.explain: «всесокрушающее железо» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.

cases.sentence: В дни тех царей Бог небес установит царство, которое никогда не погибнет и не перейдет к ___.
cases.explain: «другому народу» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

cases.sentence: Таково значение видения о камне, отколовшемся от горы, без помощи ___ — камне, разбившем железо, бронзу, обожженную глину, серебро и золото на куски.
cases.explain: «человеческих рук» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

cases.sentence: Затем царь возвысил Даниила и дал ему множество ___.
cases.explain: «ценных подарков» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the king made Daniel great, and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon, and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

cases.sentence: Даниил попросил царя, и царь поставил Шадраха, Мешаха и Аведнего над делами провинции Вавилон, тогда как сам Даниил остался при ___.
cases.explain: «царском дворе» — after the preposition «при», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon; but Daniel was in the king’s gate.
